extracted.name: Brown Rice
extracted.description: This robust rice is the perfect side dish to serve with any meat, or with vegetables. Long-grain white rice is baked with beef broth, French onion soup, butter, Worcestershire sauce, and basil.
ingredient_lines: 1 (10.5 ounce) can condensed French onion soup
instruction_lines: Preheat oven to 350 degrees F (175 degrees C).
In a 2 quart casserole dish combine rice, broth, soup, butter, Worcestershire sauce and basil.
Bake covered for 1 hour, stirring once after 30 minutes.
